summary: Blast radius: serde_json float_roundtrip is enabled on atip and, by feature unification, on every crate of the workspace that builds with it (canon-cli, canon-store and the rest), so how canon reads every JSON float changes, not only the digest's; the manifest comment says the feature is additive, which is true, but the change names no test of canon outside atip that holds the old reading. I ran only the atip and atip-probe tests. Effect.detail is also now a JSON value (was a String): a source-breaking change for a caller that sets or reads detail as text; the CHANGELOG records it.
